concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work. Compiler-emitted structures are fresh and owned by the caller; the volatile run envelope is the only per-call value and never enters the plan body.
inputs: in-memory resources, or explicit source/file paths read only through the accepted loader
purpose: Be a pure offline function: a successful compile or a rejection starts no component, performs no registry or filesystem discovery, opens no network connection, mutates no external state, returns no partial or executable plan on rejection and detects late mutation of an already-hashed input.
state: Pure in-memory function with no module-level mutable state, cache, singleton or ambient read.

static_checks.expected: ast scan reports no forbidden import and no ambient clock/locale/environment read
static_checks.rule: no forbidden import (subprocess, socket, threading, multiprocessing, http, urllib.request, time, datetime, os.environ access) exists in experiment_plan.py
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse, jsonschema meta-schema validation, additive diff scope check)
